mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO adi_document_graph_edge (kb_uuid, doc_uuid, segment_uuid, source_name, target_name, description, weight) VALUES
(#{r.kbUuid}, #{r.docUuid}, #{r.segmentUuid}, #{r.sourceName}, #{r.targetName}, #{r.description}, #{r.weight})
ON CONFLICT (kb_uuid, source_name, target_name, segment_uuid) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT e1.source_name AS name, e1.target_name AS targetName, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e2.segment_uuid) FROM adi_document_graph_edge e2 WHERE e2.kb_uuid = e1.kb_uuid AND e2.source_name = e1.source_name AND e2.target_name = e1.target_name AND e2.segment_uuid != e1.segment_uuid) AS otherContributors FROM adi_document_graph_edge e1 WHERE e1.segment_uuid = #{segmentUuid}

SELECT e1.source_name AS name, e1.target_name AS targetName, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e2.segment_uuid) FROM adi_document_graph_edge e2 WHERE e2.kb_uuid = e1.kb_uuid AND e2.source_name = e1.source_name AND e2.target_name = e1.target_name AND e2.doc_uuid != e1.doc_uuid) AS otherContributors FROM adi_document_graph_edge e1 WHERE e1.doc_uuid = #{docUuid}

SELECT source_name AS sourceName, target_name AS targetName, string_agg(COALESCE(description, ''), chr(10) ORDER BY id) AS description, SUM(COALESCE(weight, 1.0)) AS weight FROM adi_document_graph_edge WHERE doc_uuid = #{docUuid} GROUP BY source_name, target_name ORDER BY source_name, target_name LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM adi_document_graph_edge WHERE doc_uuid = #{docUuid}
